description: How a four-level thinking selector (Off / Low / Medium / High) of a coding-agent client maps to what the llama-server chat templates of Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.8 understand. Each value is the set of fields to ADD to the body of POST /v1/chat/completions. See docs/en/05-thinking-budgets.md.
notes: enable_thinking=false makes the template render an empty <think></think>: no thinking at all. Sending nothing is NOT 'off': the server then thinks up to its --reasoning-budget (8192 here).
thinking_budget_tokens (alias reasoning_budget_tokens) is a per-request cap on thinking tokens. A ceiling, not a target.
The Qwen3.8 template only accepts reasoning_effort in {xhigh (default), medium, low}. Any other value, including 'high', raises an exception and the server answers HTTP 500.
The Qwen3.6 template has no reasoning_effort: do not rely on it.
preserve_thinking=true keeps earlier reasoning in the history, which keeps the prompt prefix stable (95-98 % of prompt tokens served from the cache).
